features.title: agent-comms
features.summary: Agent-to-agent coordination is a JSON handoff under the workspace handoff tree, validated against the packaged handoff-v1 schema, with HTML reports as optional evidence.

features.title: agent-monitoring
features.summary: Telemetry ingests Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code session metadata into a local SQLite store behind an allowlist gate; runtime artifacts live in registry zones and expire through dadaia doctor.

features.title: agent-orchestration
features.summary: Role ownership, dispatch purity, task discipline and review checkpoints; the ordered lifecycle is carried by SDD documents and agent dispatch, never by a runtime.

features.title: agentic-entities
features.summary: The entity registry defines the workspace method abstractly and every scaffolded sub-agent, hook and rule file derives from it; the behavior map binds each skill and scoped rule file to one law section.

features.title: public-asset-distribution
features.summary: The stage, install and doctor chain distributing the agentic surface into runtime roots, with hash-compare overwrite, rendered agents, whole-folder skills and a privacy gate.

features.title: pypi-distribution
features.summary: dadaia-workspace publishes to PyPI from the release workflow under OIDC trusted publishing; pyproject version is the single source of the number, and minting is separate from publishing.

features.title: Harness — Claude Code
features.summary: Claude Code is the only harness with native sub-agent dispatch, loading the law through the CLAUDE.md import chain and running the nine-agent roster under the Python hooks.

features.title: Harness — Codex
features.summary: Capability and scaffold truth for the Codex harness — native AGENTS.md discovery, version-qualified hook certification, Starlark command policy and the .codex/ projection.

features.title: Harness — Kimi Code
features.summary: Kimi Code is a Layer-1 entry harness whose live wiring is four POSIX shims registered in a managed block of the user-level Kimi config; it binds through DADAIA_CONTEXT.

features.title: brand-identity
features.summary: The panel's canonical palette and CSS tokens, homed in one module and extended per theme.

features.title: panel
features.summary: The panel serves a loopback-only, no-auth, Host-guarded, CSP-constrained four-tab UI over local workspace state; the Agents tab is its only governance editor.

features.title: product-vision
features.summary: dadaia-workspace is a local-first environment for context-bound agent work — canonical specs and memory, deterministic gates, a document-governed lifecycle and auditable evidence.

features.title: spec-context-project
features.summary: The central unit of dadaia-workspace — one main repository is the sole source of specs, bind, memory, releases and backlog, and associated repositories extend it without a second specs tree.

features.title: Consumer validation gate
features.summary: The canonical release gate is a consumer-side validation agent running the shipped recipe on a real workspace; a deterministic internal gate never approves a release by itself.

features.title: context-management
features.summary: Spec Context Projects and their repositories through a v3 registry, one resolution authority, one repo accessor, bind-driven injection and expiring presence records.

features.title: cross-platform-portability
features.summary: core/platform.py is the single capability seam and the container selects adapters; security failures are loud, non-security features degrade explicitly, unsupported capabilities fail at construction.

features.title: server-registry
features.summary: An internal registry of dev-server ports with TTL and PID tracking, an expiry sweeper that distinguishes unprobable from dead PIDs, and a read-only scan against real OS listeners.

features.title: workspace-doctor
features.summary: dadaia doctor classifies every entry of the root, the harness dirs, .dadaia/ and states/ with one finding verdict derived from the zone registry, reports the context invariants, and is the only cleanup engine.

features.title: workspace-init
features.summary: dadaia init provisions the venv, creates the registry's init zones and the selected harness roots, seeds the state files and the harness profile, then stages and installs public assets.

features.title: audits-canon
features.summary: An audit is a committed folder holding AUDIT.md and FINDINGS.jsonl; three pillars always run together over the window since the last audited milestone.

features.title: sdd-bug-backlog-governance
features.summary: The bug ledger, the backlog live photo and the release state document — one record per bug, one write seam, one exit record per backlog slug, one mutable _RELEASE.json per release.

features.title: sdd-gate-v3
features.summary: The merged PreToolUse gate enforces root whitelist, venv and cache posture, path class, phase and caller mode; the git chokepoints enforce the publication boundary and the denylist scan.

features.title: specs-doctor
features.summary: dadaia specs doctor coordinates structural, memory, release, closure/audit, governance and coherence validators over the v6 canon; it reports, never blocks, and fixes only deterministic state.
